description: This file defines the 'NotesPage' React component for a note-taking application's frontend. It manages displaying, adding, editing, and deleting notes utilizing hooks, components, and API calls.

methods.name: fetcher
methods.description: A function to fetch notes data from the API using fetch and parse the response as JSON.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Opens the modal for creating a new note.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Opens the modal pre-filled with the selected note for editing.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation and refreshes the notes list.
